book.name: Fes Kings
book.title: Fes Kings King Salaman En Najalot King

content: Deibid bin dalim Salaman wanim blanga dum
Wal wen King Deibid bin gulijap dai, imbin jingat langa im san Salaman blanga dalim im wanim im garra dum.
Imbin tok, “Im gulijap taim blanga mi blanga dai na. Langa ebrijing yu dum yu garra lafta jidan strongbala en nomo bradin langa enijing,

en yu garra lafta dum wanim YAWEI det trubala God dalim yu. En yu garra duwit langa ol detlot lowa weya God bin gibit langa Mosis blanga raidimdan. Wen yu dum lagijat loda gud ting garra hepin langa yu nomeda weya yu go.

If yu dum wanim YAWEI tok, wal im garra kipum det pramis weya imbin meigim garram mi wen imbin tok main bigininimob garra oldei jidan king blanga Isreil if dei kipum detlot lowa blanga YAWEI en trastimbat im.

“En najawan ting du. Yu sabi wanim Joweb bin dum. Imbin kilim det dubala boswan blanga ola Isreil solja. Det dubala men bin Ebna det san blanga Nera, en Amasa det san blanga Jetha. Yu sabi hau deibin kilim det braja blanga Joweb en sambala pipul langa wo. Wal afta na wen wibin ol jidan gudbalawei na Joweb bin kaman en kilim det dubala blanga peiyimbek, bat dei nomo bin dum enijing rong, en blanga tharran na mi oldei abumbat loda trabul, dumaji im na bin meigim ebrijing rong blanga mi.
Yu sabi wanim yu garra dum. Yu kaan larram im dai miselp.
“Bat yu garra oldei kain langa ola san blanga Basilai brom det taun gulum Giliyad, en yu garra maindimbat langa olabat, dumaji deibin oldei maindimbat mi wen aibin ranawei brom yu braja Ebsalom.

“En Shimiyai, det san blanga Gira brom det taun gulum Bahurim langa det kantri blanga Benjamin klen, imbin tok brabli nogudbalawei du blanga mi wen aibin kamat deya langa Mahanaiyim, bat wen minbala bin midap deya langa Jodan Riba aibin meigim strongbala pramis langa det neim blanga YAWEI nomo blanga kilim im.
Bat yu kaan larram im go friwan. Yu sabi wanim yu garra dum. Im kaan jidan laibala. Yu garra kilim im.” Lagijat na King Deibid bin tok.
King Deibid bin dai
Wal King Deibid bin dai na en deibin berrim im langa Jerusalem.
Imbin jidan king langa Isreil 40 yiya en langa det taim imbin jidan langa Hebran 7 yiya en naja 33 yiya langa Jerusalem.
Salaman bin jidan king afta im dedi Deibid, en imbin jidan brabli strongwan king du.
Edanaija bin dai
Wal Heigith bin det mami blanga Edanaija. En Edanaija bin go langa Bethshiba hubin det mami blanga Salaman. Bethsheba bin tok, “Wotfo yu kaman iya? Yu kaman gudbinjiwei langa mi?”
Wal Edanaija bin tok, “Yuwai. Bat aibin kaman blanga askim yu samting.” Bethshiba bin tok, “Wanim?”

Wal Edanaija bin tok, “Yu sabi ai bina jidan det nyuwan king en ebribodi langa Isreil bin wandim mi. Bat najing. Im nomo bin hepin! Main braja im jidan king na, dumaji YAWEI bin wandim im blanga jidan king.
En ai garra askim yu wanmo ting na, en nomo nokambek mi.” “Wanim tharran?” Bethsheba bin tok.

Wal Edanaija bin tok, “Ai wandim yu blanga askim King Salaman blanga gibit mi Ebisheg det gel brom Shunam blanga jidan main waif. Ai sabi King Salaman kaan nokambek yu blanga larram mi deigim Ebisheg.”
Bethshiba bin tok, “Orait, ai garra tok langa det king blanga yu.”

Brom deya Bethsheba bin go blanga tok langa det king blanga Edanaija. Det king bin jandap en imbin pudumdan im hed raitdan langa graun lida langa im mami. En afta imbin jidan langa im speshalwan tjeya en deibin bringimap najawan tjeya blanga im mami, en imbin jidan raidensaid langa im.
Wal Bethshiba bin tok, “Ai garra askim yu samting en yu nomo nokambek mi.” En King Salaman bin tok, “Wanim yu wandim, mami? Ai kaan nokambek yu.”
Bathseba bin tok, “Larram yu braja Edanaija deigim Ebisheg blanga jidan im waif.”

Wal det king bin tok na, “Wotfo yu askimbat mi blanga gibit Ebisheg langa Edanaija? Maitbi yu garra askim mi blanga meigim im king du, dumaji im main bigwan braja en Abaiyatha det serramonimen en Joweb dubala oldei bekimap im!” Lagijat na imbin tok.
Wal Salaman bin meigim pramis garram det neim blanga YAWEI, “Wal larram God kilim mi if ai nomo panishim Edanaija blanga wanim im askimbat mi.

YAWEI na bin meigim mi jidan strongbala king afta main dedi Deibid, en imbin kipum im pramis en imbin gibit ola kantri langa mi en langa main biginini olabat wen dei garra kaman bambai. En trubala ai dalim yu. Edanaija garra dai tudei na.” Lagijat na Salaman bin meigim det pramis.
Wal King Salaman bin dalim Benaiya blanga kilim Edanaija, en imbin go en kilim im.
Salaman bin andimwei Abaiyatha

Wal afta na King Salaman bin tok langa Abaiyatha det serramonimen, “Yu gobek langa yu ronwan kantri Einanoth. Ai bina kilim yu ded, bat najing. Ai kaan kilim yu ded na, dumaji yubin det boswan blanga det Seikridwan Boks blanga YAWEI wen yubin jidan iya garram main dedi Deibid, en yubin oldei album im wen imbin abum trabul.”

Wal wen Salaman bin dalim Abaiyatha blanga libum det serramonimen wek weya imbin oldei dumbat blanga YAWEI, ebrijing weya YAWEI bin tok longtaim langa det kantri gulum Shailo bin hepin trubalawan blanga det serramonimen neim Ilai en im bigininimob.
Joweb bin dai

Wal Joweb bin oldei album Edanaija, bat nomo Ebsalom. En wen Joweb bin irrim wanim bin hepin, imbin go kwikbala langa det Seikridwan Tent blanga YAWEI en imbin holdim det dubala kona blanga det teibul blanga ofring.

Wen Salaman bin irrim Joweb bin ranawei langa det Seikridwan Tent en imbin deya langa det teibul blanga ofring, Salaman bin jandim wanbala mesinja langa Joweb blanga askim im wotfo imbin ranawei langa det Seikridwan Tent. Joweb bin dalim det mesinja, “Aibin kaman iya langa YAWEI, dumaji aibin bradin blanga Salaman.” Brom deya King Salaman bin jandim Benaiya blanga kilim Joweb.

Benaiya bin go langa det Seikridwan Tent en imbin tok langa Joweb, “Det king wandim yu blanga kamat.” “Nomo! Ai garra dai iya!” Joweb bin tok. Benaiya bin gobek en imbin dalim det king wanim Joweb bin tok.

Wal King Salaman bin tok, “Yu garra dum wanim Joweb bin tok. Yu garra kilim im en berrim im wulijim mi en eni femilimob blanga King Deibid garra jidan nomo garram eni bleim brom detlot trabul weya bin kaman wen Joweb bin kilim det dubala men hu nomo bin dum enijing rong.

Wal YAWEI garra panishim Joweb dumaji imbin kilim det dubala, en main dedi Deibid nomo bin sabi tharran. Joweb bin kilim det dubala hu nomo bin dum enijing rong, en dubala bin mobeda langa im. Ebna bin det boswan solja blanga ola Isreil ami, en Amasa bin det boswan solja blanga ola Juda ami.
YAWEI garra panishim Joweb en ola bigininimob blanga im olagija blanga det dubala. Bat YAWEI garra gudbinji olawei langa Deibid en im bigininimob weya dei garra jidan king afta im.”
Wal Benaiya bin go insaid langa det Seikridwan Tent blanga YAWEI en imbin kilim Joweb, en deibin berrim im langa det plein kantri gulijap langa im ronwan kemp.
Det king bin pikimat Benaiya blanga deigim pleis blanga Joweb, en imbin pikimat Seidok det serramonimen blanga dum det wek blanga Abaiyatha.
Shimiyai bin dai
Wal King Salaman bin jandim wed langa Shimiyai en imbin tok, “Yu garra bildimap haus blanga yu iya langa Jerusalem. Yu garra jidan iya en yu kaan libum dijan taun.
If yu gowei brom iya en krosoba langa det krik gulum Kidron, wal yu garra dai en det bleim garra go langa yuselp.” Lagijat na King Salaman bin tok.
Wal Shimiyai bin tok, “Orait main Haibala King. Ai garra duwit langa yu.” En imbin jidan langa Jerusalem longtaim.
Bat wen 3 yiya bin gopas, dubala wekinmen blanga Shimiyai bin ranawei langa Geth. Deibin go langa King Ekish, det san blanga Meiyaka. Wen Shimiyai bin irrim det dubala bin langa Geth,
imbin go garram im dongki raidap langa King Ekish deya langa Geth blanga gajim im wekinmen en deigimbek dubala langa im kemp.
Wen Salaman bin irrim wanim Shimiyai bin dum,

imbin jandim wed langa Shimiyai blanga kaman langa im. En imbin tok, “Yubin meigim pramis langa mi langa det neim blanga YAWEI nomo blanga gowei brom Jerusalem. En aibin dalim yu trubala if yu gowei, wal yu garra dai. Wal yubin agri blanga dijan en yubin tok yu garra lisin langa mi.
Wotfo yubin breigim yu pramis en yu nomo bin duwit langa mi?
Yu sabi brabliwei ola rong ting weya yubin oldei dum langa main dedi Deibid. YAWEI garra panishim yu blanga tharran.
Bat YAWEI garra gudbinji langa Deibid en im bambaiwan bigininimob garra ol jidan seifwan olagija.” Lagijat na Salaman bin tok.
Brom deya King Salaman bin dalim Benaiya blanga kilim Shimiyai, en imbin go en kilim im. En Salaman bin jidan brabli strongbala bos blanga ebrijing.
